title: Chapter 147
content:
Chapter 147

The body moved forward suddenly, Jueying's incomparably amazing lightness kung fu, just a few flashes, the body turned into several glimpses, quickly approaching the incomparably powerful man in front of him.

With a loud shout, Xu Chu suddenly pulled out his big knife, and slashed at the man who was rushing towards him, as if he wanted to cut it in two.

Looking at the big knife that was attacking him, Jueying didn't feel any surprise. With a flash of his body, he turned his body abruptly in mid-air.

After dodging the big knife, the long sword slashed lightly, leaving a bloodstain on Xu Chu's body, but it was not fatal. Even for Xu Chu, his perverted body, which is not an ordinary person, was not considered any harm, it was just a tickle.

Wielding the broadsword again, he aimed at Jueying behind him, and when he had just changed his move to take a breath and had no time to move, he grabbed the gap and slashed at him again.

With a bang, the big knife and Jueying's sharp sword collided suddenly, making a metallic sound.

Jueying, who was far less powerful than Xu Chu, slammed into the pillar in the hall behind him. With a bang, the pillar shook for a while, but stopped firmly and did not fall down.

But Jueying spit out a mouthful of blood suddenly, and felt a sharp pain in his body, and all the bones in his body seemed to be broken and shattered into pieces.

He forced himself to stand up, stuck the sword in the ground, stood up slowly, then drew out the sword, and pointed it at Xu Chu again.

"You are a very strong opponent, stronger than that person just now, no, maybe you are stronger than that person in melee combat, that person is a natural general, and should be hired on the battlefield. And you, is A natural guard, someone who is protected by you will definitely feel very at ease!" Gritting his teeth, Jueying said these words, and he had to admit that the person in front of him was absolutely unstoppable for an assassin like him. strong strangle. Facing him is like facing a hedgehog, and it is still a hedgehog protected by a turtle shell, so it is difficult to attack.

"Yes, I am very strong, and I am the nemesis of your type of enemy. Under my sword, you have no reason to survive. You should obediently present your head and let me contribute my merits and receive the reward!" Xu Chu said these words in a frenzy, swung his sword, and rushed towards Jueying.

"Damn it, even if you are my nemesis, don't be so arrogant, my dignity as a first-class master cannot be insulted!" He cursed bitterly, and Jue Ying raised his Jue Ying sword again, and the extremely fast figure swept away. However, while dodging, he kept looking for gaps to assassinate Xu Chu.

Clang, clang, the sound of swords colliding quickly sounded, and then fell quickly.

The two kept waving the weapons in their hands, looking for one killing opportunity after another, trying to put the enemy in front of them to death.

…………

At this time, Zhang Fei swung the Zhangba Snake Spear in his hand countless times, provoking soldiers one after another, and guards one after another, as if he couldn't kill them all.

However, Zhang Fei didn't have any fear of the enemies surrounding him. Instead, he was extremely excited. The blazing flames of war in his chest seemed to come out of his chest and burn the entire hall.

All the people around who looked at Zhang Fei could feel the will to fight, and the blood in their bodies couldn't help but follow Zhang Fei's rhythm and flow.

"Haha, happy, happy, it's been a long time since I had such a happy fight, tnnd bird, since I came out, I haven't had such a hearty battle for a long time!" A swearing came out of Zhang Fei's mouth, but he stretched out his hand even more He is so vigorous that every time he swung the Zhangba Snake Spear, he could bring out more than a dozen soldiers and fly backwards.

The soldiers brought by Lord Yanchun died very soon. After all, this is the capital of the Yan Kingdom, so there is no problem with safety. After all, it is also one of the Seven Heroes of the Warring States Period. Who would dare to come here without long eyes? presumptuous?

So Yanchun Jun only brought three hundred guards this time, plus more than ten guards headed by Jue Ying. In his mind, it was absolutely enough to protect his own life. After more than ten years of experience, Also tell him that such a configuration is definitely enough.

But how could he have imagined that he would meet such a freak as Zhong Yu? When traveling, he brought several first-class masters with him, and he was surrounded by several top players in the Jianghu, so his luck was already at home, and his ideas were difficult to grasp.

Then he can eat a dish that he can't swallow.

With Zhang Fei's extremely efficient killing, like a humanoid machine, with every breath and every second, the lives of more than ten or twenty soldiers were taken away by him, and three hundred guards, for Zhang Fei, at most That's a matter of a minute or two.

The reason why it took so long was mainly because the dozen or so bodyguards brought by Mr. Yanchun were all top players in the Jianghu, the best of the second rate.

For Zhang Fei, even if he was first-rate, it would be extremely difficult to deal with the dozen or so second-rate masters, so the end of the battle was delayed extremely slowly.

"Dian Wei, show them that you are as brave as the ancient evil! Let the people of the world see your might!" Pointing in Zhang Fei's direction, he said to Dian Wei who was still staying beside him.

"Oh——, the last general obeys!" With a howl, he patted his chest with both fists, then raised the two painted halberds stuck on the ground, bent his legs slightly, and then jumped up violently, with a bang, It fell on Zhang Fei's side.

clang!

Zhang Fei's Zhang Ba Snake Spear swiped at Dian Wei, but Dian Wei easily blocked it with his painted halberd.

"Yide, it's me, see clearly before hitting!" Dian Wei was suddenly hit, feeling extremely upset, and shouted to Zhang Fei loudly.

"Who asked you to come? To deal with these people, I, Lao Zhang, alone is enough. I don't need your help!" Zhang Fei replied angrily, thinking that Dian Wei had robbed his opponent.

"Hey, my lord has a life. Seeing that you are playing so slowly, let me help you. I told you that you can't do it. No, you're right!" Dian Wei laughed a few times, but Dian Wei said jokingly.

"His grandma is a ball, why can't I, Lao Zhang, it's just that these loaches are too slippery, always hiding, and they are too spineless!" He cursed a few times, and for these guards who only knew how to hide, they ran around like a mouse. Fleeing, given Zhang Fei's fierce generals, it's really difficult to catch them.

"Okay, let's not talk about it, let's wipe out these ants quickly, so as not to make the Lord unhappy after waiting for a long time!" Dian Weilang laughed a few times, waved his painting halberd, and slashed at the soldiers in front of him, causing waves of anger. Bloody.

"Okay, let's compete to see who kills more!" Zhang Fei also returned, strenuously moving forward, without saying a word, but focused on killing the enemy in front of him.
